capabilities.title: Open local application
capabilities.description: Open an installed Windows application from app_inventory.

target_schema.description: Display name or alias of an installed local app.

safety_rules: Must resolve through app_inventory before execution.
Shell-like apps such as PowerShell, cmd, and terminal are blocked.
planner_guidance: Use exact app_inventory display names when possible.

capabilities.title: Focus local application
capabilities.description: Bring an already running installed Windows application window to the foreground.

target_schema.description: Display name or alias of an installed local app.

safety_rules: Must resolve through app_inventory before execution.
Only focuses an existing visible window; it does not launch the app.
planner_guidance: Use focus_app when the user asks to switch to or return to an app.

capabilities.title: List visible windows
capabilities.description: Inspect currently visible top-level desktop windows without changing them.
safety_rules: Read-only desktop state inspection; does not focus, close, or modify windows.
planner_guidance: Use before focus_app when the user asks what is open or target window state is unclear.

capabilities.title: Focus window
capabilities.description: Bring a specific existing desktop window to the foreground by title, app name, or hwnd.

target_schema.description: Window title, installed app name, or hwnd:<number>.

safety_rules: Only changes foreground focus; does not launch apps or close windows.
planner_guidance: Use for explicit window-title focus requests or when app_inventory matching is uncertain.

capabilities.title: Minimize window
capabilities.description: Minimize a specific existing desktop window by title, app name, or hwnd.

target_schema.description: Window title, installed app name, or hwnd:<number>.

safety_rules: Only changes window state; does not close or modify app data.
planner_guidance: Use when the user asks to hide or minimize a window/application.

capabilities.title: Maximize window
capabilities.description: Maximize a specific existing desktop window by title, app name, or hwnd.

target_schema.description: Window title, installed app name, or hwnd:<number>.

safety_rules: Only changes window state; does not close or modify app data.
planner_guidance: Use when the user asks to maximize or enlarge a window/application.

capabilities.title: Restore window
capabilities.description: Restore a minimized or maximized desktop window to normal visible state.

target_schema.description: Window title, installed app name, or hwnd:<number>.

safety_rules: Only changes window state; does not close or modify app data.
planner_guidance: Use when the user asks to restore, show, or unminimize an existing window/application.

capabilities.title: Close window
capabilities.description: Request a specific desktop window to close by title, app name, or hwnd.

target_schema.description: Window title, installed app name, or hwnd:<number>.

safety_rules: May trigger unsaved-work prompts or close an application window.
planner_guidance: Use only when the user explicitly asks to close a window/application.

capabilities.title: Open URL
capabilities.description: Open a web URL in the default browser.
safety_rules: Only http and https URLs are accepted.
planner_guidance: Use search URLs when the exact domain is uncertain.

capabilities.title: Open project or known folder
capabilities.description: Open a known project or common user folder from projects.json.

target_schema.description: Project name, known folder name, or existing folder path.

safety_rules: Only opens existing folders; never creates, deletes, or modifies files.
planner_guidance: Use for Desktop, Downloads, Documents, current workspace, and named local projects.

capabilities.title: Open folder

target_schema.description: Existing local folder path or Desktop.

safety_rules: Never create, delete, or modify files.

capabilities.title: Open file
safety_rules: Never create, delete, or modify files.

capabilities.title: Answer information query
capabilities.description: Fetch a direct web-backed answer and return it in the assistant UI.
safety_rules: Only performs read-only web information lookup.
planner_guidance: Use this for weather, prices, news, and factual lookups before open_url.

capabilities.title: Show tasks
capabilities.description: Show or summarize task items in the assistant UI.

target_schema.description: Task range such as today or this_week.

capabilities.title: Restore workspace
capabilities.description: Restore a previously known workspace layout.
safety_rules: Prototype does not yet perform real workspace restoration.

capabilities.title: Create reminder
capabilities.description: Create a lightweight reminder in the assistant.
